ITEM 1 | Bright yellow cubes with pale golden flesh, cut into irregular chunks about 1.5 to 2.5 cm across, moist and slightly glossy with a fibrous, pitted surface; scattered on the left side of the plate | 120
ITEM 2 | Whole and halved strawberries, deep red with lighter red interiors, glossy and juicy, with small green-white calyx remnants; some halves show a cut face with pale core, clustered at center-right of the plate | 110
ITEM 3 | Small dark blue berries, matte to slightly glossy with a dark crown, about 1 to 1.5 cm across, arranged in a curved line and small cluster on the right edge near the strawberries | 25
